segments.normalizedSource: ```objc - (void)validateToolbarItemInWindow:(SFSafariWindow *)window validationHandler:(void (^)(BOOL enabled, NSString *badgeText))validationHandler { // The system calls this when Safari's state changes in a way that requires revalidation of the extension's toolbar item. if (self.items.count == 0) { validationHandler(NO,nil); } else { validationHandler(YES, [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%lu", (unsigned long)self.items.count] ); } } ```
